events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
c=np.load('clusters.npz'); d1=np.load('marker_scores_sample1.npz',allow_pickle=True); d2=np.load('marker_scores_sample2.npz',allow_pickle=True)
S=np.vstack([d1['scores'],d2['scores']]); names=d1['score_names'].astype(str); cl=c['cluster']; samp=c['sample']; inf=np.r_[d1['inflam'],d2['inflam']]
for k in [16,20]:
 m=cl==k
 print('\\ncluster',k,'top marker scores')
 for j in np.argsort(S[m].mean(0))[::-1][:8]: print(names[j],round(S[m,j].mean(),4))
 for s in [0,1]:
  z=inf[m&(samp==s)]
  print('eye',s+1,'n',len(z),'mean',z.mean(),'median',np.median(z),'p90',np.quantile(z,.9))
print('\\nhigh inflammation eye1 cells, marker assignment')
for s in [0,1]:
 m=(samp==s)&(inf>0.15)
 labs=names[np.argmax(S[m],axis=1)]
 print('eye',s+1,'n',m.sum()); print(pd.Series(labs).value_counts().head(8).to_string())
PY"
